findings.recommendation: VERIFY_WALK_CLAUSE reads 'walk the outstanding review findings before the next review'. On an unpassed system gate that is true. On a passed system gate holding an unwalked last-slot pass, the walk returns the phase command, `/orbit:archive`, so no review follows, and the clause tells the reader one does. The delta's pass scenario applies the text to the passed gate explicitly ('the system gate unpassed or passed'). Make the clause gate-neutral, e.g. 'walk the outstanding review findings first', in the code constant, the three delta texts (orbit-run-summary-emit spec lines 24, 35, 54-56, 81) and the test's CLAUSE.
